build.method: Isolated source snapshot and direct object/link commands; shared Ninja not run. Extends the verified Beamos snapshot.
build.baseline_note: Frozen material API retained to avoid ABI mismatch with earlier linked consumers. New adapter uses explicit local semantic slots and compiles with current and frozen APIs.

fixtures: Adult Link, player position/camera/daytime and health pinned; unrelated enemies removed.
Shield-bounce flag injected on a real loaded seed, native reflection function then used. Returned seed travels naturally and collides with native enemy cylinder.
Later rooted, stun and fire hits injected at the native collision boundary; reactions, recovery, death and rewards use native updates.
Single and three-shot sequences, proximity burrowing, full flee/gasp/home return, four live Scrubs plus flowers, flower cap and scene transition exercised.
limitations: Capped ~50 ms draw cadence is not an uncapped GPU performance measurement.
Native parameter-0 seed tested; other Scrub projectile variants use the same port fallback but were not individually playtested.
Full manual fights, child shield timing, broader terrain/rooms and third-party texture packs remain open.
Known ResourceManager shutdown logger mutex warning persists from the baseline.
